name: SWSE HD
author: Johnson Michaels
description: HD texture pack: 960 textures upscaled to 2x, swapped in by the SWSE DLL at GPU upload. The game's archives are never modified. The textures are a separate download (GitHub Releases or Discord); unzip them into the textures subfolder here, and run SWSE_4GB_Patcher.exe once so the 32-bit game has room for them. NOTE: this folder is runtime data read by the SWSE DLL, not an archive patch. Switch HD textures on or off with hdtextures in SWSEMods/features.txt (a '!' in the load order also hides these textures from SWSE).
